name: Work & careers
description: Discuss workplace situations, career choices, and professional goals.

words.definition: Able to change or adapt to different needs or situations.
words.example: A flexible schedule would help employees balance work and family responsibilities.

words.definition: A situation that makes it possible to do or achieve something.
words.example: The training program gave new staff an opportunity to develop practical skills.

words.definition: To work together with another person or group toward a shared goal.
words.example: The two departments collaborated to improve customer service.

words.definition: Working well without wasting time, effort, or resources.
words.example: An efficient system would reduce delays for both staff and customers.

name: Community & housing
description: Describe neighbourhoods, local services, and housing concerns.

words.definition: Easy to reach, enter, use, or understand.
words.example: The city should make public services more accessible to residents with disabilities.

words.definition: To keep something in good condition through regular care or repair.
words.example: The landlord is responsible for maintaining the building's heating system.

words.definition: Useful or suitable for a particular need or purpose.
words.example: Living near a transit station is convenient for people who commute.

words.definition: A person who lives in a particular place.
words.example: Residents asked the council to add more lighting to the park.

name: Health & lifestyle
description: Talk about wellbeing, healthy habits, and community health services.

words.definition: The state of being comfortable, healthy, and content.
words.example: Regular exercise can support both physical health and emotional wellbeing.

words.definition: Including different things in sensible or suitable amounts.
words.example: Preparing meals at home can make it easier to maintain a balanced diet.

words.definition: To stop something from happening or arising.
words.example: A short daily walk can help prevent some health problems.

words.definition: Producing a good or helpful effect.
words.example: A quiet place to study would be beneficial to students.

name: Education & learning
description: Explain learning preferences, school programs, and education choices.

words.definition: The subjects and content included in a course or program of study.
words.example: The school updated its curriculum to include more practical projects.

words.definition: To give someone support or confidence to do something.
words.example: Teachers can encourage students to ask questions and share ideas.

words.definition: A useful supply, source, or tool that helps achieve something.
words.example: The library provides online resources for learners who study at home.

words.definition: Able to act or make decisions without relying on others.
words.example: The project helped learners become more independent researchers.
